name: Chiriguaná (Colombia)
description: Horizontal bicolour of yellow and green with a thin white diagonal line from the upper hoist to the lower fly.
history: Municipal flag of Chiriguaná, a municipality in the department of Cesar, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: thin diagonal line from the upper hoist to the lower fly
